nci_book.warning: Simple FMX minus standalone KOF does NOT isolate ex-KOF NCI. Use the separately derived NCI reconciliation; not a market-value deduction.

parent_equity_book.warning: Simple subtraction shown only as arithmetic; not ex-KOF parent book equity. Economic ownership and consolidation adjustments are required.

kof.economic_rights: All fully paid outstanding series share equally in dividends and other distributions, with no preferred dividend; all series also have equal liquidation rights. Voting and transfer rights differ.

femsa_units.valuation_method: Use distribution equivalent only for continuing dividend-right allocation; equal common-share rights apply upon liquidation. Neither denominator is actual ADR float or exact diluted shares.
femsa_units.rights_source_locations: PDF physical pp8,109-112,275; printed pp4,105-108; bylaw Article6. D receives125% of B dividends on all dividends while outstanding; noncumulative. Liquidation: equal rights for fully paid shares.

other_nci_book_reconciliation.warning: Derived book-value reconciliation only. Not market value, and not proof that all ex-KOF operations remain wholly owned.

imperialbrady.caution: Prior carrying value plus gain is not an independently verified current carrying value. Do not multiply the old stake value by 19%/37.08%; do not capitalize the gain. Other non-current financial assets are pooled, not an isolated ImperialBrady valuation.

readiness: Core capital, ownership, class rights and standalone TTM cash flows loadable. Cross-company D&A perimeter and precise interim cash lease interest require consistent assumptions; ImperialBrady value remains unavailable.

capital_convention.warning: Derived from rounded issuer ex-KOF leverage presentation at30Sep2026. Do not call these exact; respect derivatives and cash-investment perimeter. Cash-rent operating convention excludes lease debt; financing convention includes it. Post-quarter events require separate adjustment.

normalization_gaps.description: Standalone and segment D&A differ by bottle breakage; lease interest note is expense not exact cash; private holding has no separately verified current value.

postemployment_and_noncurrent_employee_b.treatment: Debt-like candidate; net of plan assets already. Do not deduct fund assets again; avoid double counting deficit funding in DCF.

income_tax_payable_noncurrent.treatment: Recognized long-term tax payable, NOT separately identified uncertain-tax provision. Debt-like sensitivity only if historic obligation omitted from normalized taxes.

current_tax_liabilities.treatment: Contains ordinary tax liabilities; do not deduct blindly in addition to normalized working capital and taxes.

deferred_tax_liabilities.treatment: Do not automatically deduct book deferred taxes or add deferred tax assets beyond cash-tax DCF.

deferred_tax_assets.treatment: No automatic addition to SOTP; value only unused benefits not already in DCF.

pension_funds_supplementary_memo_only.treatment: Supplementary fund disclosure; already considered within pension accounting. Not excess operating cash or a separate equity addition.

asr_september_2026.reported_delivery: At maturity; final settlement expected before end2026
asr_september_2026.interpretation: All-program Q3 repurchases and cash are already reflected in30Sep balances and sharecount. Similar cash size is not proof of September ASR prepayment. No source assigns those repurchases to this ASR. Do not automatically subtract another280m USD or reduce shares; use explicitly uncertain matched cash/share scenarios if required. Do not reuse initial delivery terms of December2025 ASR.

tax_contingencies.treatment: Possible, not probable, gross litigation amounts; not a verified debt-like liability. No automatic equity deduction. Retain risk disclosure, not zero-risk claim.

october_dividends_bridge.femsa_cash_status: Official payment schedule verified; exact cash outflow needs payment-date outstanding shares. September count estimate is not an audited October cash balance.
double_counting_controls: Using Nov3 KOF market equity already includes ex-dividend status; do not deduct its October dividend again from that market stake.
Standalone KOF DCF with Sep30 cash requires October distribution adjustment, unless dividends payable was already deducted.
Ex-KOF cash receives FEMSA share of KOF distribution and pays FEMSA dividend; do not add KOF receipt again within operating FCFF.
Total FEMSA dividend estimate uses Sep30 outstanding shares; mark unknown October share changes separately.
No estimate of October operating cash generation or other balance changes is included.

kof_normalization.insurance_in_ifrs_ebit_evidence: BMV operating-profit tag includes other income and other expenses. Audited insurance recoveries are in other income. 9M26 EBIT reconciles exactly to revenue less cost of sales, administrative and distribution costs plus other income less other expenses.
kof_normalization.quality: Selected2462 is a transparent operating-insurance normalization proxy, not fully reconciled IFRS exceptional-item ledger. Use sensitivity and preserve source gaps. Do not subtract disposal/insurance cash line1969.975 as if it were earnings.
kof_normalization.contingencies_action: No automatic addback; provisions and releases occur repeatedly.
